# Paypad / 페이패드

> A free, ad-free local envelope budget for irregular income, with no
> account and no bank link. Log earnings as they land, split them into
> percent or fixed envelopes across savings / debt / bills / sinking /
> flexible, see monthly and annual views, keep the leftover as a buffer,
> and back everything up as JSON.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://paypad.try-dabble.com/
Plans, earnings, envelopes and preferences stay in this browser on this
device. No accounts, no sign-in, no bank or card connection, no uploads, no
server storage, no ads, no in-app purchases, no Plus tier, no envelope cap.
Totals are grouped per currency; the app never invents exchange rates.
Export a JSON backup to survive a reinstall or move phones.

- [Home](https://paypad.try-dabble.com/): The planner
- [Privacy](https://paypad.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy

## Features

- Several named paycheck / payout plans: create, rename, duplicate (envelopes copied, earnings left empty), delete
- Income mode per plan: biweekly, monthly or irregular; plan currency
- Add earnings as they land: amount, date, optional label, optional per-entry currency
- Envelopes as a percent of income or a fixed amount; unlimited count
- Envelope categories: savings, debt, bills, sinking fund, flexible
- Percent envelopes, totals and charts recompute the moment an earning is added, edited or deleted
- Totals: income, allocated, buffer (leftover to next paycheck); clear over-allocation warning
- Allocated vs buffer bar and per-category breakdown drawn with plain CSS
- Monthly view (one month's earnings) and annual view (twelve months aggregated)
- Other currencies totalled separately, never merged with invented FX rates
- JSON export / import (also accepts simple paycheck-planner style incomes / buckets)
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
